releaseNotes:
Grow your store
Every item you sell earns your store experience, and experience raises its level. Licenses on the Computer shows your level and how far the next one is.
Grocery and Snacks are yours from the start. Beverages, Dairy, Personal Care and Cleaning each need a licence, which you can buy once your store reaches its level. Products you already sell keep their licence.
A store with a good reputation now draws more customers, and one with a poor reputation fewer.

Prices
Pricing on the Computer lists every product on your shelves with your price and today's market price. Set a new price for every shelf of a product at once, or match the market.
Market prices move a little every day. Customers may walk past a shelf priced well above the market.

Fridges
Dairy now lives in fridges. Buy a Small or Large Fridge from MarketHub. Dairy only goes in a fridge and a fridge only holds dairy, for you and for your stock clerks: carrying dairy to a shelf offers no place button, and says why.
Racks that already held dairy are fridges now, so nothing on your shelves has moved.

Card payments
The card terminal has its own keypad. Key in the total and press Charge. Every key sounds like the scanner. A wrong amount is refused before the customer's card is touched.

Statistics and Cleaning
Statistics shows your sales, your profit, your best day and your best-selling products.
Cleaning shows any spill and takes you to it, expired stock on the racks, and what your cleaners are doing.

Fixes
A missed loan installment now adds a late fee to the loan, once for each missed installment.
Auto Pay tries again every day for a bill that went overdue because the balance was short.
When a cashier leaves a desk with customers still waiting, you are told.
Stock waiting in the delivery truck now goes out of date like stock anywhere else.
The game's music, voices and sounds go quiet during a phone call or while another app plays, and come back afterwards.
Saving now happens in the background, so long games stay smooth.

Three brands for every product
Every product now comes from three brands: a Low price brand, a Medium price brand and a Premium brand. For example SaverChoice Rice, GoldenField Rice and Royal Harvest Rice.
Low price brands cost you less and sell for less. Premium brands cost more and earn the most on each item. Any customer may buy any brand.
The products you already have are now the Medium price brand, at the same price, so your stock and racks are exactly as you left them.
Products now have names used around the world: Lentils, Flour, Cottage Cheese, Yogurt and Salted Snack Mix. Money is still in rupees.

Settings, your shop and messages
Every page has one Back: the arrow at the top.
Settings is now a short menu. Volume and Announcements each open their own page.
The Shop Floor now shows your shop's name, and TalkBack reads it as your shop's name, Shop Floor.
Rename your shop from BuildMax on the Computer: a New Signboard costs 3000 rupees.
The Event Log has been removed.
The message left on screen now reads exactly what TalkBack said, with nothing added in front. It is the last thing on every page, after all the buttons, and it changes the moment something new is announced.
Messages are no longer held back while you take a payment. Everything is spoken as it happens.
